summary: This bill establishes a two-year demonstration program allowing hospitals to provide outpatient observation services to Medicare beneficiaries in their homes, waiving certain regulations to facilitate this home-based care.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a 2-year demonstration program for hospitals to provide outpatient observation services to Medicare beneficiaries at home. This expands the scope of Medicare-covered services and aims to improve access to care, which leans towards more public healthcare provision.

By expanding Medicare services to include at-home observation, the bill enhances a key component of the social safety net for elderly and disabled individuals, potentially reducing out-of-pocket costs and improving access to necessary medical care.
